Perinatal streptococcal infections Group B streptococci are a major cause of perinatal infec- tions, often leading to neonatal pneumonia or septicaemia, sometimes with meningitis, although the incidence varies in different parts of the world. Infections are acquired through maternal genital carriage during pregnancy.
